---
title: "Spatial Gene Plotter (03Slide4)"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(viridis)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load Data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Change this to the gene you want to plot
target_gene <- "FZ3" 

cat("Loading spatially mapped single-cell dataset...\n")
seurat_sc <- readRDS("../Random data/sc_with_spatial_scores.rds")

# Ensure defaults
DefaultAssay(seurat_sc) <- "SCT"
```

## 1. Prepare Data for 3D Projection

We extract the UMAP embeddings and the inferred spatial position (Smoothed Pseudotime).

```{r prepare_data}
if (!target_gene %in% rownames(seurat_sc)) {
    stop(paste("Gene", target_gene, "not found in the dataset."))
}

# Extract embeddings and metadata
plot_df <- data.frame(
    UMAP_1 = Embeddings(seurat_sc, "umap")[,1],
    UMAP_2 = Embeddings(seurat_sc, "umap")[,2],
    Spatial_Z = seurat_sc$Smoothed_Pseudotime,
    CellType = if ("celltype_granular" %in% colnames(seurat_sc@meta.data)) seurat_sc$celltype_granular else seurat_sc$celltype,
    Expression = FetchData(seurat_sc, vars = target_gene)[[1]]
)

# Handle scaling for better visualization if needed
# (Optional: use log1p or scale)
plot_df$Expression_Log <- log1p(plot_df$Expression)
```

## 2. Spatial Gene Expression (3D)

This plot shows the expression level of **`R target_gene`** across the 3D spatial map.

```{r plot_expression, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
plot_ly(plot_df, x = ~UMAP_1, y = ~UMAP_2, z = ~Spatial_Z, 
        color = ~Expression_Log, colors = viridis(100, option = "magma"),
        type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 2, opacity = 0.8),
        text = ~paste("Gene:", target_gene, "<br>Expr:", round(Expression, 2), "<br>Type:", CellType)) %>%
  layout(title = paste("Spatial Expression:", target_gene),
         scene = list(xaxis = list(title = 'UMAP 1'),
                      yaxis = list(title = 'UMAP 2'),
                      zaxis = list(title = 'Inferred Gut Position')))
```

## 3. Gene Expression per Cell Type (Violin Plot)

This plot shows the distribution of **`r target_gene`** expression across identified cell types.

```{r plot_violin, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
p_vln <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = CellType, y = Expression, fill = CellType)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste("Expression Distribution:", target_gene),
         x = "Cell Type",
         y = "SCT-Normalized Expression") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    NoLegend()

print(p_vln)
```
